Name: Cornucopia SVE Community Center Butter Patch
Description:
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod is a very very tiny compatibility patch that replaces [b]SVE Butter[/b] with [b]Cornucopia butter[/b] in the custom [b]SVE community center bundles [/b](included by default in SVE).[/size][/color]

[b][size=4][u]Does this mod apply to me?[/u][/size][/b]
This mod is for you IF AND ONLY IF:
[list]
[*]You are playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/*]
[*]You have the Stardew Valley Expanded "SVE Community Bundles" or "Hard SVE Community Bundles" enabled in SVE config settings[/*]
[*]You are playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url][/*]
[*]You have the Cornucopia - Artisan Machines "SVE Compat Patch" enabled in Cornucopia - Artisan Machines config settings[/*]
[*]You are starting a new save[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][u]What does this mod do?[/u][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod ONLY works on new saves[/*]
[*]SVE Butter item is replaced with Cornucopia Butter, making the artisan goods bundle completable without spawning any items or disabling any mods[/*]
[*]If using the hard SVE bundles, SVE Butter Churner reward is replaced with Cornucopia's Butter Churn, instead of giving you an error item[/*]
[/list]You need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens (CMCT)[/url] installed for this to work. Again, community center bundles cannot be changed on an existing save.

(Why is this a separate mod? Because this cannot be added directly to Cornucopia without requiring CMCT.)
